jobs.prompt:
Use case: background-extraction / identity-preserve.
Asset type: ONE isolated transparent PNG mascot cutout for compositing beside an EXISTING CSS microscope slide on a website.
Reference 1 is the USER APPROVED five-slide composition board. Extract/adapt ONLY the specified character and specified props from that approved scene. Reference 2 is the original standing drawing for identity. Preserve the approved mascot's flat drawing, face, proportions, colors, mittens, thin legs and shoes; do NOT redesign, beautify or render as a 3D toy.
Target: LEFTMOST Team figure: small original mascot standing and waving its left/outside mitten toward viewer, RIGHT/inward white mitten extends at shoulder height to hold the near vertical edge of a glass slide just OUTSIDE RIGHT of the character. Right hand is rightmost point. All of slide omitted, nothing else added. Feet rest on same baseline.
CRITICAL output: only this single mascot and its specified props, actual transparent alpha everywhere else. Absolutely NO glass, NO slide fragments, NO frame, NO edge line, NO shadow rectangle, NO label, NO icon, NO ground/background, NO floating sparkles. Character hands pose as though touching an invisible slide boundary, but that boundary is not drawn. No dark background. Include every visible hood/fin/shoe/mitten and any books, laptop or speech bubble, in a tight centered full-body square composition with ~8% transparent margin. The inward touching hand should be the leftmost or rightmost point so it can overlap a real CSS slide edge. Sparse flat navy/lavender/pink/white shapes from originals. No text or watermark. Preserve the character from its approved scene as closely as possible.
